data.name: Planewalkers
data.detailed_description:
Super Mario 64 meets Fall Guys.

Challenge yourself and your opponents in this rage platformer with a unique and wide variety of movement options.

Whether you enjoy the game in multiplayer, where your friends become your greatest foes, or in solo-mode, where your only opponents are gravity and your own temper - once you enter the Planes only skill and patience will get you to the top.

An unexpected journey lies ahead.

A specific focus on difficult and complex movement as well as carefully designed obstacles meant to synergize with the unique movement provides a party gaming experience not found in any other multiplayer platformers.

Invite your friends to a challenge to see who will master traversing the planes and who will be left behind.

A variety of game modes, from elimination and race based maps to point based games awaits you to rank against your opponents and emerge as victor. Pick or vote for a map each round that suits your skills.

In Singleplayer the only enemy you will face is yourself.

Without skill and patience you won't be able to reach the top in these large and vertical beasts of a map, where a single misstep can send you all the way to the bottom.

Pick from an ever expanding pool of clothes and cosmetics to face the challenges ahead of you with style.

Download now and join the fray.

P.S.: This will always be a handcrafted game without AI slop and without microtransactions or other questionable monetization methods.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: 4-Core 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 or similar
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: 8-Core 3.8 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 or similar
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for multiplayer.
